description: This file defines a custom exception handler for asynchronously executed methods in a Spring application. It implements the AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler interface and logs exception details and method parameters when an uncaught exception occurs during asynchronous execution.

classes.name: CustomAsyncExceptionHandler
classes.description: A class that handles uncaught exceptions thrown in asynchronous Spring methods, logging exception details for debugging.

methods.name: handleUncaughtException
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions from asynchronous methods by logging the exception, method name, and method parameters.
